title: pulmonaria villosula
intro: Pulmonaria villosula, commonly known as Lungwort, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Pulmonaria villosula include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to relieve symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Pulmonaria villosula include glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
